records.source: Exosphere: SpaceX does not publish header volumes. Sized (30 t at O/F 3.6) so the estimated Flight 14 flip and terminal-burn profile reaches water contact from the full continuous return with margin; 20 t from an ideal landing delta-v did not close it. Stations from public cutaway descriptions (LOX header in the nose, CH4 header inside the LOX tank)
records.conditions: capacity and station of each embedded header tank; the same mass is removed from the main tank so the stage total is unchanged
records.uncertainty: capacity ±50%; station ±2 m; tied to the estimated landing profile
